verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, so portfolio operations can be scripted. It also offers dashboard portfolio management and default auto-renew, and one user reports moving "a bunch of domains" from GoDaddy smoothly. There is no evidence of native bulk search, registration, renewal or transfer tooling. Bulk nameserver changes are effectively ruled out because Cloudflare-registered domains must use Cloudflare nameservers. Missing for 10: documented native bulk search/registration/transfer workflows, bulk renewal controls, the ability to change nameservers at all, and hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk operations.
